Relaxation and adventure await at My Happy Place in Serenity at Dune Allen on 30A; boasting 2,151 square feet and offering accommodations for up to 13 guests in 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms.



This charming Florida home, located in the Serenity Community, is situated in beautiful, sunny Dune Allen Beach, and has a rejuvenating coastal ambiance. As you approach the over-sized covered front porch, you will notice it is adorned beautifully with ''Old Chicago'' brick. With 10 foot ceilings & huge 8 foot doors on both the first and second level, this open and airy home, exuding a modern coastal ambience, will offer you and your whole family the peace & tranquility of the ideal coastal getaway.

It's prime location, a short skip from Scenic Highway 30A, is just minutes from the sugary-white shores of Dune Allen Beach, as well as plenty of shopping, entertainment, and dining options, all along County Highway 30A!



Beautiful hardwood floors, Granite counter-tops, Shiplap Walls, and beachy undertones are just a few of the features that make this multi-level home worthwhile escape. The living room offers comfy furnishings while the dining area offers seating for up to 4 guest, with additional seating for 3 at the breakfast bar. The large, open-plan Living and Dining Room offer plenty of room for entertaining the whole family, with plenty of room on the couch around the large, wall-mounted TV.



The Master Suite is located on the first floor; sporting a king-sized bed and a private, luxurious bathroom, complete a double vanity and walk-in shower. The second floor holds three additional guest bedrooms: one with a king-sized bed & full bed, along with a shared Bathroom with a walk-in shower, two guest bedrooms with a queen size beds and a twin-over-full bunk alcove.



This home comes with a 6-Seater Golf Cart and 6 Beach Cruiser Bicycles to help you get to the beach in style!

 

This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn!

(Excludes Beach Towels)



SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 13):

- Master Suite, First Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom II, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

Bring your Beach Towels and Stay Awhile!!



Guest Access:

Beach Access: My Happy Place in Serenity at Dune Allen on 30A enjoys access to several nearby (peaceful and secluded) Beach Access points.  The closest, the Dune Allen Regional Beach Access is located roughly 0.4 miles from the home, witth restrooms, plenty of parking, and a lifeguard station.



This home is also a short 0.7 miles from the West Allen Loop Public Beach Access. It comes complete with a shower, plenty of bike parking and a few spaces for carts, but no parking for cars.



Pool Access: The community of Serenity at Dune Allen on 30A features a community pool with bathrooms! The pool is just a short (about 2 minute) stroll south.



Nearby Restaurants:

Nearby restaurants to My Happy Place on 30A include: Stinky’s Fish Camp, Vue on 30A, Elmo’s Grill, Pizza by the Sea, La Playa, JC Seafood House Restaurant, The Perfect Pig, Publix Supermarket, Cantina Laredo, Tommy Bahama, Travinia Italian Kitchen, and more!



The Neighborhood:

The community of Serenity at Dune Allen Beach is centrally located along 30A among the Beaches of South Walton, an area long celebrated for its eclectic cuisine, unique boutique shopping, scenic bike and foot paths and some of the most challenging golf courses the Gulf Coast has to offer! It's is a short walk or bike ride to Gulf Place Town Center, hosting a plethora of local shops and artists. Use the provided bikes to cruise the Timpoochee bike trail (which runs parallel to scenic highway 30A).  Serenity at Dune Allen on 30A is the perfect place to celebrate your family’s next beach vacation!



30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar-white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairytale-like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



Getting Around:

Enjoy our street-legal 6-seater golf cart & 6 adult Beach Cruiser bicycles to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to the beach, Gulf Place, Blue Mountain and more!

(Amenity Fees added at checkout)



Other Things to Note:

Attention: Please note our age requirement policy: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.



Please note, two (2) night reservations are subject to a lower max occupancy. A two night reservation max sleeping capacity is equal to half of the standard max occupancy restriction for the unit.



Rates, availability and minimum stay requirements are subject to change without notice.



* Promotions may change, be cancelled and dates may be blacked out at BeachWalk's sole discretion and without notice.



No Pets: No pets of any kind are permitted in My Happy Place on 30A. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



No Smoking: Smoking in any form (e.g. cigarettes, cigars, “e-cigarettes” or “vapes”) are not permitted in My Happy Place. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



Golf Cart: The Golf Cart is provided to the Guest by a 3rd Party Vendor, BeachWalk Vacation Gear, LLC ("BVG, LLC"). The rental policy signed is between the Guest and BVG, LLC. Golf Cart is not owned or provided to the Guest by the Homeowner or BeachWalk Vacation Properties, LLC.



You MUST be 21 years or older WITH a valid Driver’s License to operate the cart!

Please observe all posted speed limits and observe all traffic laws.

Golf Cart cannot be driven on Nature Trails, Boardwalks or sidewalks.



Trailers/RV's are not allowed in this communty
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
